description: Declared ownership map for Hybrid AllSky UI consolidation.

classic.description: Legacy Classic UI pages, templates, APIs and assets that still need parity review before removal.

modern.description: Native Modern UI pages and assets.

modern_wrapper.description: Modern UI safe-control wrappers over legacy/backend actions.

shared_api.description: APIs and shared routes used by Classic, Modern or backend consumers.

public.description: Public routes and latest media endpoints.

known_dynamic.description: Routes/assets/templates referenced dynamically and not reliably detected by static analysis.

protected_modern_work.description: Modern/profile/multicamera/scientific features that must not be broken during porting.

multi_camera.label: Multi-camera
multi_camera.modern_gap: Some wrapped legacy tools may still assume single-camera behavior.
notes: Do not flatten camera_id/profile_id semantics.

camera_profiles.label: Camera Profiles
camera_profiles.modern_gap: Needs clearer ownership labels for profile-scoped settings.
notes: Modern Camera Settings is canonical for profile-owned camera fields.

profile_first_configuration.label: Profile-first configuration
profile_first_configuration.modern_gap: Basic/Advanced/Developer UX split is not implemented yet.
notes: Classic global config must not become canonical over profile values.

auto_exposure.label: Auto Exposure
auto_exposure.modern_gap: Decision/blocker explanation is mostly logs and dashboard context.
notes: Exposure-first remains binding.

auto_gain.label: Auto Gain
auto_gain.modern_gap: Runtime apply/restore behavior needs clear UI explanation.
notes: Default apply remains disabled unless explicitly configured.

hybrid_awb.label: Hybrid AWB
hybrid_awb.modern_gap: Hardware-specific fields need more explanatory help.
notes: Do not sync CFA/debayer blindly between different cameras.

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.modern_gap: Metadata source readiness needs clearer UX.
notes: Daily JSONL metadata is shared infrastructure, not UI-only.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.modern_gap: Classic chart options may not be fully ported.
notes: Keep shared chart APIs until parity is proven.

quality.label: Quality
quality.modern_gap: Quality flags need richer user-facing explanations.
notes: Quality metadata must stay backward compatible with older rows.

environmental_awareness.label: Environmental Awareness
environmental_awareness.modern_gap: Needs Raspberry field validation and threshold tuning.
notes: Read-only diagnostics; no runtime decisions.

event_foundation.label: Event Foundation
event_foundation.modern_gap: No review UI and no production detector yet.
notes: Shadow-only event evidence must not be promoted silently.

scientific_source_layer.label: Scientific Source Layer
scientific_source_layer.modern_gap: Native scientific source review UX is not complete.
notes: Never promote display images to scientific detector input.

detector_meteor_foundations.label: Detector / Meteor foundations
detector_meteor_foundations.modern_gap: Detector implementation is blocked pending real outdoor FITS validation.
notes: Domain contracts are separate from UI and runtime detection.

modern_admin_shell.label: Modern Admin shell
modern_admin_shell.modern_gap: Some nav targets are wrappers or placeholders.
notes: Future admin shell is Modern.

modern_safe_controls.label: Modern safe controls
modern_safe_controls.modern_gap: Wrappers are transitional and need native replacements later.
notes: Wrapper means partial parity, not removal readiness.

image_capture.label: Image Capture
image_capture.modern_gap: Settings ownership is still split across multiple pages.
notes: Do not change capture timing from UI consolidation.

camera_settings.label: Camera Settings
notes: Save & Sync must preserve hardware identity fields.

exposure.label: Exposure
notes: Exposure remains the primary brightness control.

gain.label: Gain
notes: Gain is last-resort after exposure.

white_balance_awb.label: White Balance / AWB
notes: Hardware-specific.

image_save.label: Image Save
notes: Do not confuse display save with scientific source save.

fits_save.label: FITS Save
fits_save.modern_gap: Scientific source persistence modes are not user-friendly yet.
notes: FITS paths are detector-grade source candidates.

raw_source_files.label: RAW / Source Files
raw_source_files.modern_gap: No native source file review workflow yet.
notes: RAW export remains optional and detector-neutral.

darks.label: Darks
darks.modern_gap: Dark management parity needs runtime validation.

bad_pixel_maps.label: Bad Pixel Maps
notes: Backend exists but UI mapping is not fully confirmed.

mask.label: Mask
mask.modern_gap: Shape-aware multicamera behavior needs UI clarity.
notes: Do not reintroduce binning-only mask caches.

adu.label: ADU
adu.modern_gap: Needs clearer relation to Auto Exposure/Gain.

sqm.label: SQM
sqm.modern_gap: Native Modern SQM status is limited.
notes: SQM failures must remain non-fatal.

image_lag.label: Image Lag
image_lag.modern_gap: Modern page exists, but Classic data semantics should be verified.

image_viewer.label: Image Viewer
image_viewer.modern_gap: Read-only Modern image list/detail exists; exclude/delete/processing/download parity remains blocked pending explicit media action and path policy.

fits_image_viewer.label: FITS Image Viewer
fits_image_viewer.modern_gap: Modern has read-only FITS metadata inspection, local usability filters, and metadata-only detail; conversion/viewer parity remains Classic-only.
notes: Do not remove Classic before scientific source review UX and conversion/viewer parity are understood.
Modern FITS inspection must remain metadata-only and must not call fits2jpeg, download, process, delete, scan files or read arbitrary paths.

panorama.label: Panorama
panorama.modern_gap: Public/latest behavior is not replaced by Modern Admin.

raw_viewer.label: Raw Viewer
raw_viewer.modern_gap: No native source review view yet.

timelapse.label: Timelapse
notes: Generated products must remain camera-scoped.

startrail_video.label: Startrail Video
startrail_video.modern_gap: Public watch/share parity must be preserved.

latest_image.label: Latest Image
latest_image.modern_gap: Modern Admin is not a public route replacement.

public_media_endpoints.label: Public media endpoints
public_media_endpoints.modern_gap: External usage is not statically knowable.
notes: Do not remove because static consumer is absent.

meteor_detection.label: Meteor Detection
meteor_detection.modern_gap: No real Hybrid detector yet; blocked pending outdoor FITS validation.
notes: Legacy Hough code is not yet a real detector.

star_detection.label: Star Detection
star_detection.modern_gap: No dedicated UI ownership map yet.
notes: Shape-aware masks must remain multicamera-safe.

event_candidate_triggers.label: Event Candidate Triggers
event_candidate_triggers.modern_gap: Runtime diagnostics visible; no review UI yet.
notes: Shadow-only.

event_review.label: Event Review
notes: Architecture exists in Event Framework; UI absent.

config_history.label: Config History
config_history.modern_gap: Modern read-only config history with local usability filters exists. Restore/download remain Classic-only.
notes: Modern page must not expose raw config payload, download config data, or mutate active configuration.

config_restore.label: Config Restore
config_restore.modern_gap: Modern read-only inspection with local usability filters and metadata-only detail exists; restore action still Classic-only.
notes: Modern page must not call /ajax/config/restore, expose raw config payload, download config data, or mutate active configuration.

logs.label: Logs
logs.modern_gap: Modern read-only detail exists; download parity still uses Classic endpoints.
notes: Logs support explainability.

charts.label: Charts
charts.modern_gap: Legacy chart options may not be fully ported.

task_queue.label: Task Queue
task_queue.modern_gap: Modern Admin has read-only task queue visibility; Classic fallback remains for legacy parity.
notes: Modern page is read-only and must not add delete, retry, cancel or edit actions.

user_management.label: User Management
user_management.modern_gap: Modern Admin has read-only account inventory, local usability filters, and privacy-safe detail; profile/password/role changes remain Classic-only.
notes: Modern page must not show password hashes, API keys, login IPs or raw user data.
Modern usability filters are client-side and read-only.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.modern_gap: Modern Admin has read-only notification inventory, local usability filters, and read-only detail; acknowledgement and modal flow remain Classic/shared.
notes: Modern page must not call /ajax/notification POST or acknowledge notifications.
Modern usability filters are client-side and read-only.

admin_tools.label: Admin Tools
admin_tools.modern_gap: Several admin tools are wrappers only.

storage_drives.label: Storage / Drives
notes: FITS/RAW storage impact should become user-visible.

environmental_sensors.label: Environmental sensors
environmental_sensors.modern_gap: Weather awareness is not implemented as operational logic.

power_ups.label: Power / UPS
power_ups.modern_gap: Presence and UI ownership need verification.

youtube_oauth.label: YouTube / OAuth
notes: External callback routes must be preserved until replaced.

sync_api.label: Sync API
notes: Do not treat as Classic UI.

action_api.label: Action API
action_api.modern_gap: Modern capture service action is separate.

external_api_clients.label: External API clients
external_api_clients.modern_gap: External use is not statically knowable.

classic_ui_shell.label: Classic UI shell
notes: Do not remove shell until parity and deprecation are complete.

legacy_ajax_endpoints.label: Legacy AJAX endpoints
legacy_ajax_endpoints.modern_gap: Some are shared and some are legacy-only.
notes: Needs endpoint-by-endpoint ownership refinement.

shared_ajax_endpoints.label: Shared AJAX endpoints
shared_ajax_endpoints.modern_gap: Modern sometimes uses shared legacy save/action paths.

vendor_js_css.label: Vendor JS/CSS
notes: Do not remove vendor assets without runtime verification.

datatables.label: DataTables
datatables.modern_gap: Table pages need native Modern parity.

photoswipe.label: PhotoSwipe
photoswipe.modern_gap: Modern gallery does not use PhotoSwipe.

dynamically_loaded_assets.label: Dynamically loaded assets
dynamically_loaded_assets.modern_gap: Static analysis may miss runtime loading.

direct_navigation_routes.label: Direct navigation routes
direct_navigation_routes.modern_gap: Static consumer absence does not mean unused.

bookmark_public_routes.label: Bookmark/public routes
bookmark_public_routes.modern_gap: External usage cannot be known statically.

unknown_needs_verification.label: Unknown / Needs Verification
unknown_needs_verification.modern_gap: Catch-all feature used only to prevent unmapped inventory items from being invisible.
notes: Items matching this feature may also match more specific features; do not use this as evidence of removal safety.
